title: Northgate Optical Eyewear Guarantee: Remakes, Non-Adapt Remakes and Design Switches
content:
These clauses of the Northgate Optical eyewear guarantee govern when a job may be remade, the free remake for a patient who cannot adapt to the lens design, and the switch of a job to another lens design.

**Clause 1 — Remakes and their entries.** A remake is opened only on dispensed eyewear. Opening a remake sends the job back to the lab (its status becomes remake in lab) and raises its remake count by one. Every remake posts a remake charge entry carrying its remake number and remake reason — 0.00 when a guarantee covers it.

**Clause 2 — Limit on remakes.** A job is remade at most the number of remakes of any kind its lens design allows per job. The count relied on is the remake count in the system record of that eyewear job.

**Clause 3 — Non-adapt window.** A non-adapt remake is free only when it is requested no later than the lens design's non-adapt window, in calendar days, after the dispensed date of the job. Days are counted as calendar days, the dispensed date being day 0; a request on the last day of the window is within it. The dispensed date relied on is the one in the system record of the job.

**Clause 4 — Number of free non-adapt remakes.** A job gets at most the design's number of free non-adapt remakes. They are counted, over the life of the job, as the remake charge entries on that job whose remake reason is non-adapt.

**Clause 5 — Switching design.** Where the lens design allows a design switch, the non-adapt remake may switch the job to another lens design; the job then carries the new design. When the new design's base lens price is higher, the member pays the difference as the remake charge. The former clause under which, when the new design's base lens price is lower, the difference on the base-lens charge is credited as a return refund is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current switch-down basis.

**Clause 6 — Dispensed date.** The dispensed date is the date of the first dispensing and never moves with a remake.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Lens design (non-adapt window) | Dispensed | Non-adapt remake requested | Day count | Within the window |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses (30 days) | 1 May 2025 | 31 May 2025 | day 30 | yes |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses (30 days) | 1 May 2025 | 1 June 2025 | day 31 | no |
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses (0 days) | any date | any later date | — | no; the design carries no non-adapt guarantee |

## Points of judgement

- *A Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses job, allowed two free non-adapt remakes, already shows two remake charge entries with the non-adapt reason.* A third non-adapt remake is not free under clause 4.
- *A Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses job charged 69.99 for its lenses, with no discount, is remade for non-adapt into Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses (99.99).* The new design is higher; the member pays the 30.00 difference as the remake charge (hypothetical job).
- *A job has already been remade as many times as its design allows.* No further remake is opened under clause 2.
